_comment: Every value marked TODO blocks launch. `npm run check` fails while any TODO remains. Change values here, never in the page files.
tagline: Turn what you feel into a clear conversation for your next appointment.

cta._comment: mode is one of: email | instagram | appstore. Swapping mode changes the primary action everywhere. appstore needs appStoreUrl. email needs emailEndpoint (a same-origin or first-party POST endpoint that stores only the address).

analytics._comment: Off by default. If enabled, provider must be cookieless and must not collect personal data (self-hosted Plausible or Umami on this domain). The script is only loaded if the visitor has not opted out on the privacy page.

cookieBanner._comment: Nothing on this site sets a cookie or reads device storage without a user action, so no consent banner is legally required. The component exists and is switched off. Turn on only if a consent-requiring technology is ever added.

founder._comment: show=false keeps the founder invisible. Nothing on the site names a person while this is false.
founder.name: Oliwier

pricing.currencyNote: Prices are shown in US dollars and will be shown in your local currency on the App Store.
